svg.aria-label: Mantelpiece · Topology — one QR, one hosted backend, one governed tool surface
svg.text: Mantelpiece · Topology — one QR, one hosted backend, one governed tool surface

Phones upload straight to S3; ingest is deterministic Rust except where keepers and highlights reach a model; agents reach data only through the Gateway, and irreversible tools only with a token a person minted.
saved broadcast: IVS writes HLS to the Recordings bucket → recording-ended rule
rule forwards trip.detected only → Workflow #1 Trip Curator
Lambda target: the same API Lambda
apply_dedup · apply_cleanup · delete_media · share_album · remove_contributor: without the token, Policy denies
made and deleted by the API
pairing · uploads · /events · /ask · reel plans · films · live · confirmations
face search when People is on
Terrarium terrain tiles · AWS Open Data

SignalMachine runs per original; OrganizeMachine runs per household after an upload batch or a saved broadcast. Model calls go to keepers (enrich) and highlights (field notes); the rest of a burst inherits.
The Concierge rule forwards trip.detected only. The agent's router also handles contribution.received, dedup.proposal, cleanup.candidates and nightly.tick; no rule forwards those yet.
The Gateway's Cedar policy requires a confirmation token on apply_dedup, apply_cleanup, delete_media, share_album, remove_contributor; an owner's or co-editor's session mints it, never an agent.
Place names come from Amazon Location Places. The Echo Show custom skill (a Python Lambda) calls the same API with an account-linked token.
